title: Trace the monitoring control loop
description: Switch scenarios to see when serving health, telemetry completeness, delayed outcomes, and mitigation disagree.

nodes.label: Product traffic
nodes.detail: Represents the requests and people exposed to a model-backed decision. Exposure must be measured by release and approved cohort.

nodes.label: Serving path
nodes.detail: Loads compatible features and a pinned model, applies the decision policy, and returns a result within the serving objective.

nodes.label: Decision log
nodes.detail: Stores the prediction ID, event time, model and feature versions, bounded summaries, cohort, action, and outcome join key.

nodes.label: Outcome source
nodes.detail: Produces observed outcomes after the product-specific delay. Some outcomes may never arrive, so absence and lateness need explicit measurement.

nodes.label: Outcome join
nodes.detail: Joins predictions to outcomes by stable key and computes label coverage before evaluating quality on cohorts old enough to be complete.

nodes.label: Monitoring rules
nodes.detail: Combines service, contract, drift, labeled quality, and product guardrails with sample-size and persistence requirements.

nodes.label: Response owner
nodes.detail: Uses a runbook to investigate, reduce exposure, roll back, choose a safe fallback, and restore traffic gradually with evidence.

scenarios.label: Healthy loop
scenarios.summary: Serving meets its objective, prediction events arrive, and the mature outcome cohort has enough coverage to evaluate quality.
scenarios.result: All four planes have current evidence. The system remains healthy only while service, data, model, and product guardrails agree; no response action is required.

scenarios.label: Blind telemetry
scenarios.summary: Predictions still return, but the decision log stops accepting events after a schema change.
scenarios.result: The endpoint is available but the ML product is unobservable. Alert on telemetry loss or freshness, stop risky rollout growth, and restore compatible event delivery before claiming health.

scenarios.label: Labels pending
scenarios.summary: Live serving signals are current, but recent predictions have not had enough time to receive their product outcomes.
scenarios.result: Report the cohort as immature and publish label coverage. Continue watching service and output signals, but do not convert missing labels into false errors or compare this window with a mature baseline.

scenarios.label: Harmful slice
scenarios.summary: Aggregate service health is normal, while a mature high-risk cohort breaches its false-negative guardrail after a model release.
scenarios.result: The guardrail and release correlation justify action. Reduce exposure with the tested rollback, fallback, threshold, or review path before retraining or completing root-cause analysis.
